title: Financial Value of Nature: Coastal Housing Markets, Mangroves, and Climate Resilience
abstract: Measuring the financial value of nature is difficult, often resulting in insufficient funding directed to nature conservation and restoration. As coastal risks increase from development and climate change, a tangible benefit of nature is the protection it offers against storm damages. Many studies from the risk industry and others assess the direct effects of wetlands for reducing damage during storms. However, the value of wetlands for coastal protection could extend to many other benefits, including home prices in areas where storms are common. We use property-level housing transaction data from Zillow and show that proximity to mangroves in Florida moderates home price decline and dispersion following major hurricanes. The effects are substantial in magnitude, reducing the probability of losing a quarter or more of housing value by 2-7 percentage points, which corresponds to 20-40-thousand-dollar value for a million-dollar property, conditional on a hurricane. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 自然的金融价值：沿海住房市场、红树林与气候韧性。衡量自然的金融价值十分困难，这常常导致用于自然保护与修复的资金不足。随着开发活动和气候变化导致沿海风险增加，自然的一项切实效益，便是其对风暴破坏的防护作用。风险行业及其他机构的许多研究评估了湿地在风暴期间减少损失的直接作用。然而，湿地对沿海防护的价值可能延伸至诸多其他效益，包括在风暴多发地区的房价。我们利用 Zillow 的房产层面交易数据，表明佛罗里达州的红树林邻近性能够缓和重大飓风后的房价跌幅和价格离散度。其效应规模可观：在飓风发生的条件下，它使房产价值损失四分之一或更多的概率降低了 2–7 个百分点，对于一套价值百万美元的房产而言，相当于 2–4 万美元的价值。NBER 工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: Industrial Composition of Syndicated Loans and Banks' Climate Commitments
abstract: In the past two decades, several banks have joined global initiatives aimed at enhancing the disclosure of their asset portfolios and climate commitments. We study whether banks that joined such initiatives have altered the emission exposure of their syndicated loan portfolios. We rely on loan-level data with global coverage combined with country-industry data on emissions. We find that, on average, banks have reduced the emission exposures of their syndicated loan portfolios over the last decade. However, we do not find statistically significant or robust differences between banks that did and those that did not subscribe to climate commitments. In the few instances where we found a statistically significant change after becoming a climate initiative signatory, the effect was either temporary or did not survive our robustness testing. Thus, we conclude that while banks reduced their relative lending to highly-emitting sectors on average, voluntary climate commitments did not contribute to syndicated loan reallocation away from those sectors.
abstract_zh: 银团贷款的行业构成与银行的气候承诺。过去二十年间，若干银行加入了旨在加强资产组合及气候承诺信息披露的全球倡议。我们研究了加入此类倡议的银行是否改变了其银团贷款组合的排放暴露。我们依托全球覆盖的贷款层面数据，并结合国家—行业层面的排放数据展开研究。我们发现，平均而言，过去十年间银行降低了其银团贷款组合的排放暴露。然而，我们并未发现加入与未加入气候承诺的银行之间存在统计上显著或稳健的差异。在少数我们发现成为气候倡议签署方之后出现统计上显著变化的情形中，该效应要么是暂时的，要么在我们的稳健性检验中未能保持。因此，我们得出结论：尽管银行平均而言减少了对高排放部门的相对信贷，但自愿性气候承诺并未促使银团贷款从这些部门重新配置。

title: Climate Fairness and Growth: Allocating the Remaining Carbon Budget
abstract: Limiting global warming to 1.5 degrees requires that cumulative carbon dioxide emissions remain within a finite remaining carbon budget. How this budget is allocated across countries raises questions of fairness and development. This paper evaluates whether equity-based carbon allocations are compatible with sustained economic growth in emerging and developing economies. We compute country-level fair shares of the remaining carbon budget under the equal-cumulativeper-capita (ECPC) principle. Using data for 162 countries between 1950 and 2023, we then estimate the historical relationship between income and per-capita CO2 emissions across income groups and use these elasticities to simulate cumulative emissions until 2050.Our results show that ECPC implies strongly negative remaining carbon budgets for most advanced economies, while lowerincome countries retain positive but constrained allocations. Under historically observed incomeemissions elasticities, many developing countries would exceed their fair shares when converging toward advanced-economy income levels. At the aggregate level, unused allocations offset only 17% of the combined carbon budget shortfall implied by countries exceeding their allocation and the negative fair shares arising from historical responsibilities. In a scenario in which we assume that the technology of advanced economies is transferred to all countries, the carbon budget coverage increases to 38%.
abstract_zh: 气候公平与增长：分配剩余碳预算。将全球变暖限制在 1.5 摄氏度以内，要求累计二氧化碳排放量保持在有限的剩余碳预算之内。如何在各国之间分配这一预算，涉及公平与发展的问题。本文评估了基于公平的碳分配是否与新兴经济体和发展中经济体的持续经济增长相兼容。我们依据“等量累计人均”（ECPC）原则，计算了各国占剩余碳预算的公平份额。利用 1950 年至 2023 年 162 个国家的数据，我们随后估计了不同收入群体之间收入与人均 CO2 排放的历史关系，并利用这些弹性模拟至 2050 年的累计排放量。我们的结果表明，ECPC 原则意味着大多数发达经济体的剩余碳预算为强烈的负值，而低收入国家则保有正值但受限的配额。在历史上观察到的收入—排放弹性下，许多发展中国家在向发达经济体的收入水平趋同时，将超出其公平份额。在总量层面，闲置配额仅能抵消 17% 的综合碳预算缺口，该缺口来自超额排放的国家以及由历史责任所产生的负值公平份额。在一种情景下，即假定发达经济体的技术被转让给所有国家，碳预算覆盖率将提高至 38%。

title: Firm Emissions and Credit Allocation
abstract: Do banks help or hamper green transition? To answer this question, we analyze the dynamics of bank lending to firms in the US, EU, and separately Denmark in relation to the borrowers' emissions of CO2.We evaluate the allocation of bank loans across industries and within industries across firms, allowing for heterogeneity of firm emissions and changes in these emissions. To facilitate green transition, bank lending needs to flow to greener and greening firms, but not out of high-emission industries that need funding to transition to cleaner production methods. Using syndicated loan data, we find that for US borrowers, bank lending was likely hampering green transition, while in the EU bank lending is more likely to facilitate it. Zooming in on Denmark, for which we have data on the full universe of firms and banks, we find more significant credit reallocation to greener firms, especially within industries. However, the reallocation of funds to green firms is, to a large extent, a byproduct of green firms becoming bigger. We do not find any evidence consistent with banks active stewardship of green transition.
abstract_zh: 企业排放与信贷配置。银行是帮助还是阻碍绿色转型？为回答这一问题，我们分析了美国、欧盟以及丹麦（单独考察）银行向企业贷款的动态，并考察了借款人的二氧化碳排放情况。我们评估了银行贷款在不同行业之间以及行业内部不同企业之间的配置，同时考虑了企业排放的异质性及其变化。要促进绿色转型，银行贷款需要流向更绿色和正在变绿的企业，而不应流出那些需要资金以转向更清洁生产方式的高排放行业。利用银团贷款数据，我们发现，对于美国借款人而言，银行贷款很可能阻碍了绿色转型，而在欧盟，银行贷款则更有可能促进绿色转型。聚焦丹麦（我们拥有该国全部企业和银行的数据），我们发现资金向绿色企业的再配置更为显著，尤其是在行业内部。然而，资金流向绿色企业在很大程度上是绿色企业规模扩大的副产品。我们没有发现任何证据表明银行积极履行了推动绿色转型的管理责任。

title: Pace of adoption of alternatives to animal-source foods is an important factor in reaching climate goals
abstract: The global food system is a significant contributor to greenhouse gas emissions that drive climate change. Animal agriculture accounts for a large share of food-system emissions, both directly and through the production of animal feed. Global population growth and rising incomes imply a further increase in demand for animal-source foods if current trends persist. Limiting global warming to the targets set by the international community will not be possible without the rapid reduction of a substantial share of animal-source foods. We show that the rapid adoption of alternatives to animal-source foods, such as plant-only diets or plant-based, cultured, or fermentation-derived analogs to animal products, can be consistent with climate goals while satisfying global demand for calories and protein. Importantly, timing is crucial: the longer the delay in adopting alternatives, the larger the share of the diet that must shift away from animal-source food by 2050 for the food system to remain within its carbon budget.
abstract_zh: 动物源性食品替代品的采纳速度是实现气候目标的重要因素。全球食品系统是导致气候变化的温室气体排放的重要来源。畜牧业在食品系统排放中占据很大份额，既包括直接排放，也包括饲料生产带来的间接排放。如果当前趋势持续，全球人口增长和收入上升将意味着对动物源性食品需求的进一步增加。若不快速减少相当大比例的动物源性食品，就不可能将全球变暖限制在国际社会设定的目标之内。我们表明，快速采用动物源性食品的替代品，例如纯植物性饮食，或以植物为基础、细胞培养或发酵衍生的动物产品类似物，既可以与气候目标相一致，又能满足全球对热量和蛋白质的需求。重要的是，时机至关重要：采纳替代品的延迟越长，到 2050 年饮食中必须转离动物源性食品的比例就越大，食品系统才能保持在其碳预算之内。

title: Global Spillovers of Climate Policy Shocks
abstract: The slow adoption of climate change policies stems from concerns about their economic impact. The EU has led global carbon pricing through its Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS).This study examines the effect of ETS policy shocks on global stock market returns at the country-industry level using linear and spatial autoregression models. Results show that while markets react negatively to rising carbon prices, the impact is small in magnitude. Global spillovers are limited to sectors linked to EU industries via intermediate goods trade, with no significant effects beyond these supply chain linkages. Overall, the unintended consequences of EU climate policies appear negligible, with minimal effects on targeted industries' stock returns and no spillovers outside supply chain linkages.
abstract_zh: 气候政策冲击的全球溢出效应。气候变化政策推行缓慢，源于人们对其经济影响的担忧。欧盟通过其排放交易体系（ETS）引领了全球碳定价。本研究利用线性和空间自回归模型，在国家—行业层面考察了 ETS 政策冲击对全球股票市场收益的影响。结果显示，尽管市场对碳价上涨表现出负面反应，但其影响幅度较小。全球溢出效应仅限于通过中间品贸易与欧盟产业相关联的部门，而在这些供应链联系之外没有显著影响。总体而言，欧盟气候政策的意外后果似乎微不足道，对目标行业股票收益的影响极小，且在供应链联系之外并无溢出效应。

title: Climate Disasters and Exchange Rates: Are Beliefs Keeping Up With Climate Change?
Climate risks and FDI
abstract: Climate-related risks have increased in recent decades, both in terms of the frequency of extreme weather events (physical risk) and implementation of climate-change mitigation policies (transition risk). This paper explores whether multinational firms react to such risks by altering their presence in countries that are more affected. We measure this by examining foreign direct investment (FDI) dynamics at different levels of aggregation as well as at firm level. We propose a theoretical framework for firm production location choice that explicitly incorporates transition and physical risks. The model predicts a reduction in FDI resulting from both physical and transition risks but an ambiguous interaction effect of these risks with emission productivity of the firm. In an extensive empirical analysis we find some support for model predictions, but overall we do not find consistent evidence for statistically significant effects of physical and transition risks on FDI. However, firm-level evidence suggests that firms that are more exposed to climate risks react more negatively to physical climate risk following Paris Climate Accord. We also find that FDI outflows following extreme weather events from affected countries are smaller for industries with higher emission productivity. Our theory and empirical results point to the importance of accounting for heterogeneity in emission productivity when analyzing effects of climate risks.
abstract_zh: 气候风险与外国直接投资。近几十年来，与气候相关的风险有所增加，既体现在极端天气事件的频率上（物理风险），也体现在气候变化减缓政策的实施上（转型风险）。本文探讨了跨国企业是否会通过改变其在受影响更严重国家的存在来应对此类风险。我们在不同的加总层面以及企业层面考察了外国直接投资（FDI）的动态来衡量这一点。我们提出了一个企业生产区位选择的理论框架，该框架明确纳入了转型风险和物理风险。模型预测，物理风险和转型风险都会导致 FDI 减少，但这些风险与企业排放生产率之间的交互效应并不确定。在一项广泛的实证分析中，我们发现了一些支持模型预测的证据，但总体而言，我们没有发现物理风险和转型风险对 FDI 产生统计上显著影响的一致证据。然而，企业层面的证据表明，在《巴黎气候协定》签署之后，面临更大气候风险暴露的企业对物理气候风险的反应更为消极。我们还发现，在极端天气事件之后，受影响国家的 FDI 流出在排放生产率较高的行业中更小。我们的理论和实证结果表明，在分析气候风险的影响时，考虑排放生产率的异质性十分重要。
